title: Sutra-khanda, part 6 (portion 06)
html:
Brahma continues: the Lord in the Kali-yuga is the golden Gaura of whom the Bhagavata speaks (11.5.32); explanation of the words "krishna-varna" and "sangopanga", of Garga Muni's verse on the four colours and of the word "tatha"; Krishna is not a yuga-avatara but Bhagavan Himself, and in the Dvapara and the Kali it is He Himself who descends; testimonies of the Gita, the "Thousand Names" and the Bhavishya-purana; the greatness of the Kali-yuga and of sankirtana

তিন যুগে তিন বর্ণ কহি দিল মুনি ।
সাবধানে শুন কলিযুগের কাহিনী ॥ ৩৪৮ ॥

tina yuge tina barṇa kahi dila muni |
sābadhāne śuna kaliyugera kāhinī || 348 ||

tina yuge tina varna — three colours in three yugas; kahi dila muni — the sage named; savadhane shuna — hear attentively; kali-yugera kahini — the account of the Kali-yuga

348Of the three colours in three yugas the sage has told;
now hear attentively the account of the Kali-yuga.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (11.5.32):

কৃষ্ণবর্ণং ত্বিষাকৃষ্ণং সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গাস্ত্রপার্ষদম্ ।
যজ্ঞৈঃ সঙ্কীর্তনপ্রায়ৈর্যজন্তি হি সুমেধসঃ ॥ ৩৪৯ ॥

kṛṣṇabarṇaṃ tbiṣākṛṣṇaṃ sāṅgopāṅgāstrapārṣadam |
yajñaiḥ saṅkīrtanaprāẏairyajanti hi sumedhasaḥ || 349 ||

krishna-varnam — uttering "Krishna" (dark in colour); tvisha akrishnam — not dark in lustre; sa-anga-upanga-astra-parshadam — with limbs, sub-limbs, weapons and associates; yajnaih — by sacrifices; sankirtana-prayaih — consisting chiefly of sankirtana; yajanti — worship; hi — indeed; sumedhasah — the intelligent

349"Him who utters [the name] 'Krishna' but is not dark in lustre,1 with His limbs, sub-limbs, weapons and associates, the intelligent worship with sacrifices consisting chiefly of sankirtana."

কৃষ্ণ এই দুই বর্ণ আছয়ে যাহাতে ।
কৃষ্ণবর্ণ নাম তার কহে ভাগবতে ॥ ৩৫০ ॥

kṛṣṇa ei dui barṇa āchaẏe yāhāte |
kṛṣṇabarṇa nāma tāra kahe bhāgabate || 350 ||

krishna ei dui varna — these two syllables "Krish-na"; achhaye yahate — in whom are; krishna-varna nama tara — His name is "krishna-varna"; kahe bhagavate — says the Bhagavata

350He in whom there are these two syllables, "Krish-na",
the Bhagavata calls "krishna-varna".2

কান্তিতে অকৃষ্ণ সেই শুন সর্বজন ।
গোরা গোরা বলি গাই এই সে কারণ ॥ ৩৫১ ॥

kāntite akṛṣṇa sei śuna sarbajana |
gorā gorā bali gāi ei se kāraṇa || 351 ||

kantite akrishna sei — by lustre He is not dark; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; gora gora bali gai — we sing "Gora, Gora"; ei se karana — this is the reason

351And in lustre He is "not dark" — hear, everyone:
this is why we sing, "Gora, Gora!"

সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গ অস্ত্র যত পারিষদ আর ।
সভার সহিত প্রভু কৈলা অবতার ॥ ৩৫২ ॥

sāṅgopāṅga astra yata pāriṣada āra |
sabhāra sahita prabhu kailā abatāra || 352 ||

sanga-upanga — limbs and sub-limbs; astra — weapons; yata parishada ara — and all the associates; sabhara sahita — together with all; prabhu kaila avatara — the Lord descended

352With His limbs, sub-limbs, weapons and all His associates —
with all of them the Lord descended.

অঙ্গে বলরাম বলি তেঞি কহি সাঙ্গ ।
উপ-অঙ্গ আভরণ তেঞি সে উপাঙ্গ ॥ ৩৫৩ ॥

aṅge balarāma bali teñi kahi sāṅga |
upa-aṅga ābharaṇa teñi se upāṅga || 353 ||

ange balarama bali — Balarama is called a limb; tenji kahi sanga — therefore I say "with limbs"; upa-anga abharana — the lesser limbs are ornaments; tenji se upanga — therefore "with sub-limbs"

353Balarama is called the limb — so I say "with limbs";
the lesser limbs are ornaments — so "with sub-limbs".3

সুদর্শন-আদি অস্ত্র যত পারিষদ ।
সংহতি আইলা সভে প্রহ্লাদ নারদ ॥ ৩৫৪ ॥

sudarśana-ādi astra yata pāriṣada |
saṃhati āilā sabhe prahlāda nārada || 354 ||

sudarshana-adi astra — weapons such as Sudarshana; yata parishada — all associates; samhati aila sabhe — all came together; prahlada narada — Prahlada, Narada

354The weapons — Sudarshana and the rest — and all the associates,
Prahlada, Narada — all came together [with Him].

পূর্ব অবতারে আর দাস দাসী যত ।
সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গে অবতার নাম লৈব কত ॥ ৩৫৫ ॥

pūrba abatāre āra dāsa dāsī yata |
sāṅgopāṅge abatāra nāma laiba kata || 355 ||

purva avatare — in former descents; ara dasa dasi yata — and all the servants and maidservants; sanga-upange avatara — the descent with all His own; nama laiba kata — how many shall I name?

355The servants and maidservants of former descents —
He descended with all His own: how many shall I name?

এতেক বৈষ্ণব সব কহে অনুভবে ।
যে নাম আছিল তথা যেবা নাম এবে ॥ ৩৫৬ ॥

eteka baiṣṇaba saba kahe anubhabe |
ye nāma āchila tathā yebā nāma ebe || 356 ||

eteka vaishnava saba — all these Vaishnavas; kahe anubhave — tell from realization; ye nama achhila tatha — what name was there; yeba nama ebe — and what name now

356Of all this the Vaishnavas speak from their realization:
what name each had there and what name now.4

সামান্য মানুষে ইহা জানিব কেমনে ।
বিশ্বাস করিতে নারে অধমের মনে ॥ ৩৫৭ ॥

sāmānya mānuṣe ihā jāniba kemane |
biśbāsa karite nāre adhamera mane || 357 ||

samanya manushe — an ordinary man; iha janiba kemane — how will he know this; vishvasa karite nare — cannot believe; adhamera mane — the mind of the fallen

357How can an ordinary man know this?
The mind of the fallen cannot believe it.

এই ত কারণে মুনি কহিল বচন ।
সেই সে জানিব ইহা সুমেধা যে জন ॥ ৩৫৮ ॥

ei ta kāraṇe muni kahila bacana |
sei se jāniba ihā sumedhā ye jana || 358 ||

ei ta karane — for this reason; muni kahila vachana — the sage spoke the word; sei se janiba iha — he will know it; sumedha ye jana — who is intelligent

358For this reason the sage said:
only he who is intelligent will know it.

সঙ্কীর্তনপ্রায় যজ্ঞ ধর্ম পরকাশ ।
সুমেধা যে জন তাতে পরম উল্লাস ॥ ৩৫৯ ॥

saṅkīrtanaprāẏa yajña dharma parakāśa |
sumedhā ye jana tāte parama ullāsa || 359 ||

sankirtana-praya yajna — the sacrifice consisting of sankirtana; dharma parakasha — is revealed as dharma; sumedha ye jana — who is intelligent; tate parama ullasa — finds supreme joy in it

359The sacrifice consisting of sankirtana is revealed as dharma —
he who is intelligent finds supreme joy in it.

এতেকে কহিয়ে ইহা না মানে যে জন ।
চারিযুগে তিন বর্ণ তাহার বাখান ॥ ৩৬০ ॥

eteke kahiẏe ihā nā māne ye jana |
cāriyuge tina barṇa tāhāra bākhāna || 360 ||

eteke kahiye — therefore I say; iha na mane ye jana — whoever does not accept this; chari-yuge tina varna — three colours in four yugas; tahara bakhana — is his explanation

360Therefore I say: whoever does not accept this
has the explanation "three colours for four yugas".

কান্তি কৃষ্ণ বর্ণ কৃষ্ণ দুই হৈল এক ।
আর দুই যুগের বর্ণ ইহা নাহি দেখ ॥ ৩৬১ ॥

kānti kṛṣṇa barṇa kṛṣṇa dui haila eka |
āra dui yugera barṇa ihā nāhi dekha || 361 ||

kanti krishna varna krishna — "dark in lustre" and "dark in colour"; dui haila eka — the two become one; ara dui yugera varna — the colours of the other two yugas; iha nahi dekha — are not so

361[For him] "dark in lustre" and "dark in colour" merge into one,
while the colours of the other two yugas are not so:

কলি বা দ্বাপর দুই যুগে এক বর্ণ ।
দুই যুগে বর্ণ এক এই তার মর্ম ॥ ৩৬২ ॥

kali bā dbāpara dui yuge eka barṇa |
dui yuge barṇa eka ei tāra marma || 362 ||

kali ba dvapara — Kali and Dvapara; dui yuge eka varna — one colour in two yugas; dui yuge varna eka — in two yugas the colour is one; ei tara marma — this is his meaning

362in the Kali and in the Dvapara — in two yugas — one colour;
in two yugas the colour is one — that is his meaning;

সত্য ত্রেতা শ্বেত রক্ত দুই বর্ণ আছে ।
কলি দ্বাপরেতে এক বর্ণ হৈল পাছে ॥ ৩৬৩ ॥

satya tretā śbeta rakta dui barṇa āche |
kali dbāparete eka barṇa haila pāche || 363 ||

satya treta — in Satya and Treta; shveta rakta dui varna achhe — there are two colours, white and red; kali dvaparete — in Kali and Dvapara; eka varna haila pachhe — then a single colour

363in Satya and Treta there are two colours, white and red,
and then, in Kali and Dvapara, one colour.5

গর্গমুনির বাক্য কেনে বোল ক্রমভঙ্গ ।
ক্রমভঙ্গ নহে শুন আছে বড় রঙ্গ ॥ ৩৬৪ ॥

gargamunira bākya kene bola kramabhaṅga |
kramabhaṅga nahe śuna āche baṛa raṅga || 364 ||

garga-munira vakya — Garga Muni's words; kene bola kramabhanga — why call them a break in order; kramabhanga nahe — there is no break; shuna — listen; achhe bada ranga — there is great charm in it

364Why do you say that the order is broken in Garga Muni's words?
The order is not broken — listen, there is great charm in it.

ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ বর্তমান কহিবার তরে ।
তিন কাল কহে চারিযুগের ভিতরে ॥ ৩৬৫ ॥

bhūta bhabiṣyat bartamāna kahibāra tare |
tina kāla kahe cāriyugera bhitare || 365 ||

bhuta bhavishyat vartamana — past, future, present; kahibara tare — in order to express; tina kala kahe — he speaks of three times; chari-yugera bhitare — within the four yugas

365To express past, future and present,
he speaks of three times within the four yugas:

সত্য ত্রেতা বহি দ্বাপর বর্তমান ।
দ্বাপরেতে কৃষ্ণ-অবতার কৃষ্ণনাম ॥ ৩৬৬ ॥

satya tretā bahi dbāpara bartamāna |
dbāparete kṛṣṇa-abatāra kṛṣṇanāma || 366 ||

satya treta vahi — Satya and Treta past; dvapara vartamana — Dvapara present; dvaparete krishna-avatara — in Dvapara the descent of Krishna; krishna-nama — named Krishna

366Satya and Treta are past, Dvapara is present;
in the Dvapara is the descent of Krishna, and His name is Krishna.

ইদানীং বলিয়া তেঞি বোলে গর্গমুনি ।
ভূতকাল-ভিতরে ভবিষ্যকাল গণি ॥ ৩৬৭ ॥

idānīṃ baliẏā teñi bole gargamuni |
bhūtakāla-bhitare bhabiṣyakāla gaṇi || 367 ||

idanim baliya — saying "now"; tenji bole gargamuni — therefore Garga Muni speaks; bhutakala-bhitare — within the past tense; bhavishya-kala gani — counting the future

367That is why Garga Muni says "now",
and within the past tense he means the future.

ভবিতব্যতা যাহার আছে ইহা জানি ।
ভূতের ভিতরে তার ভবিষ্য বাখানি ॥ ৩৬৮ ॥

bhabitabyatā yāhāra āche ihā jāni |
bhūtera bhitare tāra bhabiṣya bākhāni || 368 ||

bhavitavyata yahara achhe — what is destined to be; iha jani — knowing this; bhutera bhitare — within the past; tara bhavishya bakhani — its future is described

368Knowing what is certain to be,
one speaks of its future in the past tense:

ভবিষ্যৎ অর্থে ভূত প্রমাণে পণ্ডিত ।
নিশ্চয়তা আছে তার এই ত ইঙ্গিত ॥ ৩৬৯ ॥

bhabiṣyat arthe bhūta pramāṇe paṇḍita |
niścaẏatā āche tāra ei ta iṅgita || 369 ||

bhavishyat arthe bhuta — the past in the sense of the future; pramane pandita — the learned accept; nishchayata achhe tara — it carries certainty; ei ta ingita — this is the hint

369the learned accept the past tense in the sense of the future —
it points to certainty; that is the hint.6

তথাপি তাহাতে তথা শব্দ দিল মুনি ।
শুক্ল রক্ত বলি তথা কি কাজ কাহিনী ॥ ৩৭০ ॥

tathāpi tāhāte tathā śabda dila muni |
śukla rakta bali tathā ki kāja kāhinī || 370 ||

tathapi — and yet; tahate — in it; tatha shabda dila muni — the sage put the word "tatha"; shukla rakta bali — after saying "white, red"; tatha ki kaja — what use is "tatha"; kahini — in the account

370And yet the sage put the word "tatha" ("likewise") there:
after saying "white, red", what use is "tatha" in the account?

তথা শব্দে পূর্ব-উক্ত শুক্ল রক্ত যথা ।
কলিযুগে পীতবর্ণ হবে হরি তথা ॥ ৩৭১ ॥

tathā śabde pūrba-ukta śukla rakta yathā |
kaliyuge pītabarṇa habe hari tathā || 371 ||

tatha shabde — by the word "tatha"; purva-ukta shukla rakta yatha — as the previously named white and red; kali-yuge pitavarna — yellow in the Kali-yuga; habe hari tatha — so will Hari be

371By the word "tatha" it is said: just as the white and red named before,
so in the Kali-yuga Hari will be yellow.

এবে দ্বাপরে এই কৃষ্ণতাকে গেল ।
গর্গমুনি চারিযুগে তিন কাল কহিল ॥ ৩৭২ ॥

ebe dbāpare ei kṛṣṇatāke gela |
gargamuni cāriyuge tina kāla kahila || 372 ||

ebe dvapare — now in Dvapara; ei krishnatake gela — this one has become Krishna; gargamuni — Garga Muni; chari-yuge tina kala kahila — expressed three times within four yugas

372Now, in the Dvapara, this one has become Krishna;
so Garga Muni expressed three times within the four yugas.

আমার বচন যেবা না লয় অবজ্ঞাতে ।
কি কারণে তথা শব্দ কহে ভাগবতে ॥ ৩৭৩ ॥

āmāra bacana yebā nā laẏa abajñāte |
ki kāraṇe tathā śabda kahe bhāgabate || 373 ||

amara vachana — my words; yeba na laya avajnate — whoever rejects with contempt; ki karane — for what reason; tatha shabda kahe bhagavate — does the Bhagavata say the word "tatha"

373Whoever contemptuously rejects my words,
let him say why the Bhagavata uses the word "tatha".

এতেক কহিয়ে আমি শুন মোর বোল ।
কহয়ে লোচন কথা না ঠেলিহ মোর ॥ ৩৭৪ ॥

eteka kahiẏe āmi śuna mora bola |
kahaẏe locana kathā nā ṭheliha mora || 374 ||

eteka kahiye ami — this I say; shuna mora bola — hear my words; kahaye lochana — says Lochana; katha na theliha mora — do not push my words aside

374This is what I say — hear my words;
says Lochana: do not push my words aside.

আর অপরূপ শুন শ্লোকের ব্যাখ্যান ।
এইমাত্র ব্যাখ্যা ইহা পরম প্রমাণ ॥ ৩৭৫ ॥

āra aparūpa śuna ślokera byākhyāna |
eimātra byākhyā ihā parama pramāṇa || 375 ||

ara aparupa — another wonder; shuna shlokera vyakhyana — hear the explanation of the verse; eimatra vyakhya — this alone is the explanation; iha parama pramana — this is the highest proof

375Hear yet another wondrous explanation of the verse —
it alone is right, it is the highest proof.

এই ত ব্যাখ্যার আছে অপূর্ব পূর্বপক্ষ ।
যুগ-অবতার কৃষ্ণ এ বড় অশক্য ॥ ৩৭৬ ॥

ei ta byākhyāra āche apūrba pūrbapakṣa |
yuga-abatāra kṛṣṇa e baṛa aśakya || 376 ||

ei ta vyakhyara — to this explanation; achhe apurva purvapaksha — there is a remarkable objection; yuga-avatara krishna — Krishna a yuga-avatara; e bada ashakya — this is quite impossible

376To this explanation there is a remarkable objection:
Krishna a yuga-avatara? That is quite impossible.

আর যুগ-অবতার অংশ কলা লিখি ।
আপনেই ভগবান্ ভাগবত সাক্ষী ॥ ৩৭৭ ॥

āra yuga-abatāra aṃśa kalā likhi |
āpanei bhagabān bhāgabata sākṣī || 377 ||

ara yuga-avatara — the other yuga-avataras; amsha kala likhi — are written as portions and parts; apanei bhagavan — [Krishna] is Bhagavan Himself; bhagavata sakshi — the Bhagavata is witness

377The other yuga-avataras are described as portions and parts,
[but Krishna] is Bhagavan Himself; the Bhagavata is witness.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (1.3.28):

এতে চাংশকলাঃ পুংসঃ কৃষ্ণস্তু ভগবান্ স্বয়ম্ ।
ইন্দ্রারিব্যাকুলং লোকং মৃড়য়ন্তি যুগে যুগে ॥ ৩৭৮ ॥

ete cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagabān sbaẏam |
indrāribyākulaṃ lokaṃ mṛṛaẏanti yuge yuge || 378 ||

ete cha — and these; amsha-kalah — portions and parts; pumsah — of the Purusha; krishnah tu — but Krishna; bhagavan svayam — is Bhagavan Himself; indra-ari-vyakulam — troubled by Indra's enemies; lokam — the world; mridayanti — they gladden; yuge yuge — age after age

378"All these [avataras] are portions and parts of the Purusha, but Krishna is Bhagavan Himself; age after age they gladden the world troubled by the enemies of Indra."

যুগ-অবতার কৃষ্ণ কহিব কেমতে ।
এ বচন তবে কেনে কহে ভাগবতে ॥ ৩৭৯ ॥

yuga-abatāra kṛṣṇa kahiba kemate |
e bacana tabe kene kahe bhāgabate || 379 ||

yuga-avatara krishna — Krishna a yuga-avatara; kahiba kemate — how can one call; e vachana — these words; tabe kene kahe bhagavate — why then does the Bhagavata say

379How then can one call Krishna a yuga-avatara?
Why then does the Bhagavata say these words?

বৃন্দাবনচন্দ্র যুগ-অবতার নহে ।
পূর্ণ পূর্ণ ব্রহ্ম কৃষ্ণ ভাগবতে কহে ॥ ৩৮০ ॥

bṛndābanacandra yuga-abatāra nahe |
pūrṇa pūrṇa brahma kṛṣṇa bhāgabate kahe || 380 ||

vrindavana-chandra — the moon of Vrindavana; yuga-avatara nahe — is not a yuga-avatara; purna purna brahma krishna — Krishna is the most complete Brahman; bhagavate kahe — says the Bhagavata

380The moon of Vrindavana is not a yuga-avatara:
Krishna is the most complete Brahman, says the Bhagavata.7

এই ত কারণে কিছু কহি তাহা শুন ।
অবজ্ঞা না করে কেহ কর অবধান ॥ ৩৮১ ॥

ei ta kāraṇe kichu kahi tāhā śuna |
abajñā nā kare keha kara abadhāna || 381 ||

ei ta karane — for this reason; kichhu kahi — I say something; taha shuna — hear it; avajna na kare keha — let no one disregard it; kara avadhana — pay attention

381For this reason I shall say something — listen;
let no one disregard it; pay attention.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (10.8.13):

আসন্ বর্ণাস্ত্রয়ো হ্যস্য গৃহ্ণতোঽনুযুগং তনূঃ ।
শুক্লো রক্তস্তথা পীত ইদানীং কৃষ্ণতাং গতঃ ॥ ৩৮২ ॥

āsan barṇāstraẏo hyasya gṛhṇato'nuyugaṃ tanūḥ |
śuklo raktastathā pīta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ || 382 ||

see v. 319

382"Taking bodies yuga after yuga, He had three colours —
white, red and likewise yellow; now He has become Krishna."

গর্গমুনি কহিল গভীর বড় বোধে ।
কেমনে বুঝিব ইহা আমরা অবোধে ॥ ৩৮৩ ॥

gargamuni kahila gabhīra baṛa bodhe |
kemane bujhiba ihā āmarā abodhe || 383 ||

gargamuni kahila — Garga Muni spoke; gabhira bada bodhe — with very deep understanding; kemane bujhiba iha — how shall we understand it; amara abodhe — we who lack understanding

383Garga Muni spoke this with the deepest understanding —
how can we who lack understanding grasp it?

বুদ্ধিমান্ হয় যদি জানে ভক্তজনে ।
বুদ্ধিমান্ লোক তাহা করয়ে প্রমাণে ॥ ৩৮৪ ॥

buddhimān haẏa yadi jāne bhaktajane |
buddhimān loka tāhā karaẏe pramāṇe || 384 ||

buddhiman haya yadi — if one is intelligent; jane bhakta-jane — he knows [it] from devotees; buddhiman loka — intelligent people; taha karaye pramane — accept it as proof

384He who is intelligent learns [its meaning] from devotees;
intelligent people accept it as proof.

চারিযুগে চারি বর্ণ কহিলেন মুনি ।
ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ বর্তমান ত্রিকাল-কাহিনী ॥ ৩৮৫ ॥

cāriyuge cāri barṇa kahilena muni |
bhūta bhabiṣyat bartamāna trikāla-kāhinī || 385 ||

chari-yuge chari varna — four colours in four yugas; kahilena muni — the sage spoke; bhuta bhavishyat vartamana — past, future, present; trikala-kahini — an account of the three times

385The sage named four colours in four yugas —
an account of the three times: past, future and present.

চারিযুগে তিন কাল কহিবারে চাহে ।
এই সব কথা ব্যাস এক শ্লোকে কহে ॥ ৩৮৬ ॥

cāriyuge tina kāla kahibāre cāhe |
ei saba kathā byāsa eka śloke kahe || 386 ||

chari-yuge tina kala — three times within four yugas; kahibare chahe — he wishes to express; ei saba katha — all this; vyasa eka shloke kahe — Vyasa says in one verse

386He wishes to express three times within four yugas —
all this Vyasa says in one verse.

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপর আর যুগ কলি ।
শ্বেত রক্ত পীত কৃষ্ণ চারি যুগে বলি ॥ ৩৮৭ ॥

satya tretā dbāpara āra yuga kali |
śbeta rakta pīta kṛṣṇa cāri yuge bali || 387 ||

satya treta dvapara — Satya, Treta, Dvapara; ara yuga kali — and the Kali yuga; shveta rakta pita krishna — white, red, yellow, dark; chari yuge bali — are said of the four yugas

387Satya, Treta, Dvapara and the Kali yuga;
white, red, yellow and dark — are said of the four yugas.

চারি যুগ আছে চারি কাল হয় যবে ।
আর তিন অবতার ক্রমে হয় তবে ॥ ৩৮৮ ॥

cāri yuga āche cāri kāla haẏa yabe |
āra tina abatāra krame haẏa tabe || 388 ||

chari yuga achhe — there are four yugas; chari kala haya yabe — if they were four times; ara tina avatara — then the other three avataras; krame haya tabe — would come in order

388If the four yugas had been [named as] four times,
then the three [other] avataras too would have come in order,

তবে সে কহিলে হয় যথাক্রম কথা ।
যথা অবতার কথা অনুসারে তথা ॥ ৩৮৯ ॥

tabe se kahile haẏa yathākrama kathā |
yathā abatāra kathā anusāre tathā || 389 ||

tabe se kahile — then, if spoken; haya yathakrama katha — the words would be in order; yatha avatara — as the avataras [come]; katha anusare tatha — so the words would follow

389and the statement would be sequential:
as the avataras [come], so the words would follow.

এতেকে সে ক্রমভঙ্গ হেন শ্লোকে দেখে ।
তথা শব্দে ভবিষ্যকাল গর্গমুনি লেখে ॥ ৩৯০ ॥

eteke se kramabhaṅga hena śloke dekhe |
tathā śabde bhabiṣyakāla gargamuni lekhe || 390 ||

eteke se — therefore; kramabhanga — a break of order; hena shloke dekhe — they see in such a verse; tatha shabde — by the word "tatha"; bhavishya-kala — the future time; gargamuni lekhe — Garga Muni indicates

390That is why people see a break of order in such a verse;
[but] by the word "tatha" Garga Muni indicates the future time.8

কেবা অবতার আর চারি বর্ণ কার ।
কেবা অবতারী কিবা বিচার ইহার ॥ ৩৯১ ॥

kebā abatāra āra cāri barṇa kāra |
kebā abatārī kibā bicāra ihāra || 391 ||

keba avatara — who is the avatara; ara chari varna kara — and whose are the four colours; keba avatari — who is the source of avataras; kiba vichara ihara — what is the judgment on this

391Who is the avatara, and whose are the four colours?
Who is the source of avataras — how is this to be judged?

আপনেহি ভগবান্ জন্মি যদুবংশে ।
পৃথিবীতে অবতার করে আর অংশে ॥ ৩৯২ ॥

āpanehi bhagabān janmi yadubaṃśe |
pṛthibīte abatāra kare āra aṃśe || 392 ||

apanehi bhagavan — Bhagavan Himself; janmi yaduvamshe — born in the Yadu dynasty; prithivite avatara kare — descends on earth; ara amshe — [at other times] by portions

392Bhagavan Himself is born in the Yadu dynasty,
[while at other times] He descends to earth by His portions.

বিশেষ্য বিশেষণ করি বাখানহ কেনে ।
এই সে সন্দেহ ইথে দ্বিধা তে-কারণে ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

biśeṣya biśeṣaṇa kari bākhānaha kene |
ei se sandeha ithe dbidhā te-kāraṇe || 393 ||

visheshya visheshana kari — making [one] the qualified and [the other] the qualifier; bakhanaha kene — why do you explain; ei se sandeha ithe — this is the doubt here; dvidha te-karane — hence the ambiguity

393Why do you explain [the verse] making one word the qualified and the other the qualifier? This is the doubt here, and hence the ambiguity.9

যতেক চৌযুগ তাথে অংশ অবতার ।
যুগ-অনুরূপ বর্ণ হয় তা সভার ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

yateka cauyuga tāthe aṃśa abatāra |
yuga-anurūpa barṇa haẏa tā sabhāra || 394 ||

yateka chauyuga — in all the four-yuga cycles; tathe amsha avatara — there are partial avataras; yuga-anurupa varna — a colour according to the yuga; haya ta sabhara — they all have

394In all four yugas [come] partial avataras,
and all of them have a colour according to the yuga.

ধর্মসংস্থাপন অধর্মবিনাশ-নিমিত্তে ।
প্রতিযুগে অংশ অবতার হয় তাতে ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

dharmasaṃsthāpana adharmabināśa-nimitte |
pratiyuge aṃśa abatāra haẏa tāte || 395 ||

dharma-samsthapana — for establishing dharma; adharma-vinasha-nimitte — and destroying irreligion; pratiyuge — in every yuga; amsha avatara haya tate — therefore a partial avatara comes

395To establish dharma and destroy irreligion
there is a partial avatara in every yuga.

আপনেই দ্বাপরে ভগবান্ হরি ।
অবতারশিরোমণি সভার উপরি ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

āpanei dbāpare bhagabān hari |
abatāraśiromaṇi sabhāra upari || 396 ||

apanei dvapare — Himself in the Dvapara; bhagavan hari — Bhagavan Hari; avatara-shiromani — the crest-jewel of avataras; sabhara upari — above all

396But in the Dvapara [comes] Bhagavan Hari Himself,
the crest-jewel of avataras, above all.

এবে কৃষ্ণতাকে গেলা গর্গমুনি কহে ।
শ্যামসুন্দর কৃষ্ণ বর্ণ কৃষ্ণ নহে ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

ebe kṛṣṇatāke gelā gargamuni kahe |
śyāmasundara kṛṣṇa barṇa kṛṣṇa nahe || 397 ||

ebe krishnatake gela — "now He has become Krishna"; gargamuni kahe — says Garga Muni; shyamasundara krishna — [this is] Shyamasundara Krishna; varna krishna nahe — "krishna" [here] is not a colour

397"Now He has become Krishna," says Garga Muni:
[this is] Shyamasundara Krishna, and "krishna" here is not a colour.

প্রতি দ্বাপরে অংশ কৃষ্ণনাম বর্ণ ।
তদ্রূপতাকে গেল প্রভু এই শুন মর্ম ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

prati dbāpare aṃśa kṛṣṇanāma barṇa |
tadrūpatāke gela prabhu ei śuna marma || 398 ||

prati dvapare — in every Dvapara; amsha — a portion; krishna-nama varna — with the name and colour "krishna"; tadrupatake gela prabhu — the Lord [Himself] assumed that form; ei shuna marma — hear this meaning

398In every Dvapara [comes] a portion with the name and colour "krishna";
[this time] the Lord Himself assumed that form — hear, this is the meaning.10

যেন দ্বাপরে কৃষ্ণ তেন গৌরচন্দ্র ।
কলি-দ্বাপর-যুগে এ দুই স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

yena dbāpare kṛṣṇa tena gauracandra |
kali-dbāpara-yuge e dui sbatantra || 399 ||

yena dvapare krishna — as Krishna in the Dvapara; tena gaurachandra — so Gaurachandra; kali-dvapara-yuge — in the Kali and Dvapara yugas; e dui svatantra — these two are independent

399As Krishna in the Dvapara, so [in Kali] Gaurachandra:
in Kali and Dvapara these two are independent.

এই দুই যুগে এক পূর্ণ অবতার ।
ব্যাস কহিলেন উদাহরণ ইহার ॥ ৪০০ ॥

ei dui yuge eka pūrṇa abatāra |
byāsa kahilena udāharaṇa ihāra || 400 ||

ei dui yuge — in these two yugas; eka purna avatara — one full descent; vyasa kahilena — Vyasa gave; udaharana ihara — an example of this

400In these two yugas [comes] one full avatara;
Vyasa gave an example of this.

So in the Brihat-sahasranama-stotra:

ত্বামারাধ্য তথা শম্ভো গ্রহীষ্যামি বরং সদা ।
দ্বাপরাদৌ যুগে ভূত্বা কলয়া মানুষাদিষু ॥
স্বাগমৈঃ কল্পিতৈস্ত্বঞ্চ জনান্ মদ্বিমুখান্ কুরু ।
মাঞ্চ গোপয় যেন স্যাৎ সৃষ্টিরেষোত্তরোত্তরা ॥ ৪০১ ॥

tbāmārādhya tathā śambho grahīṣyāmi baraṃ sadā |
dbāparādau yuge bhūtbā kalaẏā mānuṣādiṣu ||
sbāgamaiḥ kalpitaistbañca janān madbimukhān kuru |
māñca gopaẏa yena syāt sṛṣṭireṣottarottarā || 401 ||

tvam aradhya — worshipping you; tatha — thus; shambho — O Shambhu; grahishyami varam sada — I always accept a boon; dvapara-adau yuge — in Dvapara and the following yugas; bhutva — appearing; kalaya — as a portion; manusha-adishu — among men and others; sva-agamaih kalpitaih — with your own invented scriptures; tvam cha — you; janan mat-vimukhan kuru — make people averse to Me; mam cha gopaya — and conceal Me; yena syat — so that; srishtih esha uttarottara — this creation [may grow] ever more

401"Worshipping you, O Shambhu, I always accept this boon:
in the Dvapara and the following yugas, appearing as a portion among men and others,
you, by your own invented scriptures, turn people away from Me
and conceal Me, so that this creation may increase ever more."11

আর কিছু কহি শুন ভগবদ্গীতা ।
শ্রীমুখোদিত প্রভুর নিজ নিজ কথা ॥ ৪০২ ॥

āra kichu kahi śuna bhagabadgītā |
śrīmukhodita prabhura nija nija kathā || 402 ||

ara kichhu kahi — I tell something more; shuna bhagavad-gita — hear the Bhagavad-gita; shri-mukhodita — spoken from the holy mouth; prabhura nija nija katha — the Lord's own words

402I shall say more — hear the Bhagavad-gita,
the Lord's own words from His holy mouth.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavad-gita (4.8):

পরিত্রাণায় সাধূনাং বিনাশায় চ দুষ্কৃতাম্ ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপনার্থায় সম্ভবামি যুগে যুগে ॥ ৪০৩ ॥

paritrāṇāẏa sādhūnāṃ bināśāẏa ca duṣkṛtām |
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāẏa sambhabāmi yuge yuge || 403 ||

paritranaya sadhunam — to protect the righteous; vinashaya cha dushkritam — and to destroy the wicked; dharma-samsthapana-arthaya — to establish dharma; sambhavami yuge yuge — I appear age after age

403"To protect the righteous, to destroy the wicked
and to establish dharma, I appear age after age."12

সাধুজন-পরিত্রাণ ধর্ম-সংস্থাপন ।
অধর্ম-বিনাশ-হেতু কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৪০৪ ॥

sādhujana-paritrāṇa dharma-saṃsthāpana |
adharma-bināśa-hetu kahila e marma || 404 ||

sadhu-jana-paritrana — protection of the righteous; dharma-samsthapana — establishment of dharma; adharma-vinasha-hetu — for the destruction of irreligion; kahila e marma — this meaning was spoken

404Protection of the righteous, establishment of dharma,
destruction of irreligion — this is the meaning of what was said.

যুগে যুগে জন্ম আমি লভিয়ে আপনি ।
এই দুই যুগে জন্ম আপনেই আমি ॥ ৪০৫ ॥

yuge yuge janma āmi labhiẏe āpani |
ei dui yuge janma āpanei āmi || 405 ||

yuge yuge — "yuge yuge"; janma ami labhiye apani — I Myself take birth; ei dui yuge — in these two yugas; janma apanei ami — I am born Myself

405"Yuge yuge" — I Myself take birth;
in these two yugas I am born Myself.

এক যুগ-শব্দে কহি আর নাম যুগে ।
বিশেষণ-বিশেষ্য করি বাখানয় লোকে ॥ ৪০৬ ॥

eka yuga-śabde kahi āra nāma yuge |
biśeṣaṇa-biśeṣya kari bākhānaẏa loke || 406 ||

eka yuga-shabde kahi — with one word "yuga" I mean [the age]; ara nama yuge — the other "yuga" names [a pair]; visheshana-visheshya kari — as qualifier and qualified; bakhanaya loke — people explain

406With one word "yuga" I mean [the age], and the other "yuga" means [a pair]:
people explain [them] as qualifier and qualified.

যুগ বিশেষণ যুগের তেঞি যুগ বলি ।
এক দ্বাপর যুগ আর যুগ কলি ॥ ৪০৭ ॥

yuga biśeṣaṇa yugera teñi yuga bali |
eka dbāpara yuga āra yuga kali || 407 ||

yuga visheshana yugera — "yuga" qualifies "yuga"; tenji yuga bali — therefore I say "pair"; eka dvapara yuga — one is the Dvapara yuga; ara yuga kali — the other the Kali yuga

407"Yuga" qualifies "yuga" — therefore I say "pair":
one is the Dvapara yuga, the other the Kali yuga.13

যুগে যুগে চারিযুগ করি কেনে বল ।
পূর্ণ কৃষ্ণ-অবতার অংশ কেনে বল ॥ ৪০৮ ॥

yuge yuge cāriyuga kari kene bala |
pūrṇa kṛṣṇa-abatāra aṃśa kene bala || 408 ||

yuge yuge — "yuge yuge"; chari-yuga kari kene bala — why do you take it as the four yugas; purna krishna-avatara — Krishna's descent is full; amsha kene bala — why call it partial

408Why do you take "yuge yuge" as the four yugas?
Krishna's descent is full; why do you call it partial?

সে চারিযুগের কথা আর ঠাঁই কহে ।
তাহাও কহিব আমি মন দেহ তাহে ॥ ৪০৯ ॥

se cāriyugera kathā āra ṭhāṁi kahe |
tāhāo kahiba āmi mana deha tāhe || 409 ||

se chari-yugera katha — the statement about the four yugas; ara thain kahe — is made elsewhere; tahao kahiba ami — that too I shall tell; mana deha tahe — attend to it

409Of those four yugas it is spoken elsewhere;
that too I shall tell — attend to it.

So in the same (4.7):

যদা যদা হি ধর্মস্য গ্লানির্ভবতি ভারত ।
অভ্যুত্থানমধর্মস্য তদাত্মানং সৃজাম্যহম্ ॥ ৪১০ ॥

yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhabati bhārata |
abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham || 410 ||

yada yada hi — whenever; dharmasya glanih bhavati — there is a decline of dharma; bharata — O descendant of Bharata; abhyutthanam adharmasya — and a rise of irreligion; tada atmanam srijami aham — then I manifest Myself

410"Whenever dharma declines, O Bharata,
and irreligion rises, then I manifest Myself."

যে যে কালে যে যে যুগে ধর্মের হয় হানি ।
অধর্মের অভ্যুত্থান সে সে কালে জানি ॥ ৪১১ ॥

ye ye kāle ye ye yuge dharmera haẏa hāni |
adharmera abhyutthāna se se kāle jāni || 411 ||

ye ye kale — at whatever time; ye ye yuge — in whatever yuga; dharmera haya hani — dharma declines; adharmera abhyutthana — irreligion rises; se se kale jani — at that time, know

411At whatever time, in whatever yuga, dharma declines
and irreligion rises — know that at that very time

তদা কালে আপনাকে করিয়ে সৃজন ।
প্রতিযুগে অবতার অংশের কারণ ॥ ৪১২ ॥

tadā kāle āpanāke kariẏe sṛjana |
pratiyuge abatāra aṃśera kāraṇa || 412 ||

tada kale — at that time; apanake kariye srijana — I manifest Myself; pratiyuge avatara — the descent in every yuga; amshera karana — is by means of a portion

412I manifest Myself; [this] descent in every yuga
[takes place] by means of a portion.14

এতেকে কহিয়ে আমি শুন মোর বোল ।
কহয়ে লোচন কথা না ঠেলিহ মোর ॥ ৪১৩ ॥

eteke kahiẏe āmi śuna mora bola |
kahaẏe locana kathā nā ṭheliha mora || 413 ||

eteke kahiye ami — therefore I say; shuna mora bola — hear my words; kahaye lochana — says Lochana; katha na theliha mora — do not push my words aside

413This is what I say — hear my words;
says Lochana: do not push my words aside.

কলিযুগে গোরা কৃষ্ণ জানিয়াছি আমি ।
বিশেষ সন্দেহ মোর ঘুচাইলে তুমি ॥ ৪১৪ ॥

kaliyuge gorā kṛṣṇa jāniẏāchi āmi |
biśeṣa sandeha mora ghucāile tumi || 414 ||

kali-yuge gora krishna — that in the Kali-yuga Gora is Krishna; janiyachhi ami — I have come to know; vishesha sandeha mora — my great doubt; ghuchaile tumi — you have dispelled

414"That in the Kali-yuga Gora is Krishna I have come to know;
you have dispelled my great doubt.

আর অপরূপ শুন কলিযুগ-মর্ম ।
আশ্রমে নিস্তারে লোক সঙ্কীর্তনধর্ম ॥ ৪১৫ ॥

āra aparūpa śuna kaliyuga-marma |
āśrame nistāre loka saṅkīrtanadharma || 415 ||

ara aparupa — another wonder; shuna kali-yuga-marma — hear the essence of the Kali-yuga; ashrame — in [any] ashrama; nistare loka — delivers people; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma of sankirtana

415Hear another wonder — the essence of the Kali-yuga:
in any ashrama the dharma of sankirtana delivers people.15

দান ব্রত তপ হোম স্বাধ্যায় সংযম ।
বাসনা বিষয় যত এ বিধি নিয়ম ॥ ৪১৬ ॥

dāna brata tapa homa sbādhyāẏa saṃyama |
bāsanā biṣaẏa yata e bidhi niẏama || 416 ||

dana vrata tapa homa — charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings; svadhyaya samyama — Vedic study, self-restraint; vasana vishaya yata — [are all] desires and worldly aims; e vidhi niyama — these rules and observances

416Charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings, Vedic study, self-restraint —
these rules and observances [serve only] desires and worldly aims;

ফলভোগ-শ্রুতি শুনি সব মায়াবন্ধ ।
নাম-গুণ-মহিমা না জানে ছার অন্ধ ॥ ৪১৭ ॥

phalabhoga-śruti śuni saba māẏābandha |
nāma-guṇa-mahimā nā jāne chāra andha || 417 ||

phalabhoga-shruti shuni — hearing the Vedic promises of fruits; saba maya-bandha — all are bound by maya; nama-guna-mahima — the glory of the name and virtues; na jane chhara andha — the wretched blind do not know

417hearing the shruti's promises of fruits, all fall into the bonds of maya;
the glory of [the Lord's] name and virtues the wretched blind do not know.

কর্মসূত্রে বন্দী জীব ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে ।
নিবৃত্তি নাহিক কর্ম নারে সম্বরিতে ॥ ৪১৮ ॥

karmasūtre bandī jība bhramite bhramite |
nibṛtti nāhika karma nāre sambarite || 418 ||

karma-sutre bandi jiva — the soul bound by the thread of karma; bhramite bhramite — wandering on; nivritti nahika — there is no cessation; karma nare sambarite — cannot restrain karma

418The soul bound by the thread of karma wanders on,
and there is no end [for it]: karma cannot be restrained.

প্রলয়ের কালে সব কর্মবন্ধ ঘুচে ।
হেন বন্ধ ঘুচে কৃষ্ণকথা যবে পুছে ॥ ৪১৯ ॥

pralaẏera kāle saba karmabandha ghuce |
hena bandha ghuce kṛṣṇakathā yabe puche || 419 ||

pralayera kale — at the time of dissolution; saba karma-bandha ghuche — all bonds of karma are loosed; hena bandha ghuche — such bonds are loosed; krishna-katha yabe puchhe — when one asks about Krishna

419[Only] at the dissolution of the world are all the bonds of karma loosed —
but these bonds are loosed when one asks about Krishna.16

হেন গুণসঙ্কীর্তন কলিযুগ-ধর্ম ।
ঘোর পাপময় বোলে না জানিয়া মর্ম ॥ ৪২০ ॥

hena guṇasaṅkīrtana kaliyuga-dharma |
ghora pāpamaẏa bole nā jāniẏā marma || 420 ||

hena guna-sankirtana — such sankirtana of virtues; kali-yuga-dharma — is the dharma of the Kali-yuga; ghora papamaya bole — they call [Kali] terrible and sinful; na janiya marma — not knowing its essence

420Such sankirtana of [the Lord's] virtues is the dharma of the Kali-yuga;
not knowing its essence, people call [Kali] terrible and sinful.

যুগধর্ম সঙ্কীর্তন ঘুচাবে কেমনে ।
কে বা ধর্মসংস্থাপন করে প্রভু বিনে ॥ ৪২১ ॥

yugadharma saṅkīrtana ghucābe kemane |
ke bā dharmasaṃsthāpana kare prabhu bine || 421 ||

yuga-dharma sankirtana — the yuga-dharma, sankirtana; ghuchabe kemane — how could [anyone] abolish; ke ba dharma-samsthapana kare — who establishes dharma; prabhu vine — but the Lord

421How could [anyone] abolish the dharma of the yuga, sankirtana?
Who but the Lord establishes dharma?

পূর্ব-প্রতিজ্ঞা গীতায় প্রভুর বচনে ।
প্রভু অবতার হয় যেই যেই কারণে ॥ ৪২২ ॥

pūrba-pratijñā gītāẏa prabhura bacane |
prabhu abatāra haẏa yei yei kāraṇe || 422 ||

purva-pratijna — the former vow; gitaya prabhura vachane — in the Gita, in the Lord's words; prabhu avatara haya — the Lord descends; yei yei karane — for what reasons

422[Such is] the Lord's former vow in the Gita, in His words:
for what reasons the Lord descends.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavad-gita (4.8):

পরিত্রাণায় সাধূনাং বিনাশায় চ দুষ্কৃতাম্ ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপনার্থায় সম্ভবামি যুগে যুগে ॥ ৪২৩ ॥

paritrāṇāẏa sādhūnāṃ bināśāẏa ca duṣkṛtām |
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāẏa sambhabāmi yuge yuge || 423 ||

see v. 403

423"To protect the righteous, to destroy the wicked
and to establish dharma, I appear age after age."

সাধুজন-পরিত্রাণ অধর্ম-বিনাশ ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপন প্রতিযুগেতে প্রকাশ ॥ ৪২৪ ॥

sādhujana-paritrāṇa adharma-bināśa |
dharmasaṃsthāpana pratiyugete prakāśa || 424 ||

sadhu-jana-paritrana — protection of the righteous; adharma-vinasha — destruction of irreligion; dharma-samsthapana — establishment of dharma; pratiyugete prakasha — are manifested in every yuga

424Protection of the righteous, destruction of irreligion,
establishment of dharma are manifested in every yuga.

কলিযুগে সঙ্কীর্তন ধর্ম ইহা মান ।
কলি-গোরা-অবতার কভু নহে আন ॥ ৪২৫ ॥

kaliyuge saṅkīrtana dharma ihā māna |
kali-gorā-abatāra kabhu nahe āna || 425 ||

kali-yuge sankirtana dharma — in the Kali-yuga the dharma is sankirtana; iha mana — accept this; kali-gora-avatara — Gora, the avatara of Kali; kabhu nahe ana — it is never otherwise

425Accept this, then: in the Kali-yuga the dharma is sankirtana,
and the avatara of Kali is Gora; it is never otherwise."

ইহা বলি কোলাকুলি করে মুনিসনে ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল ব্রহ্মা আপনা না জানে ॥ ৪২৬ ॥

ihā bali kolākuli kare munisane |
ānande bihbala brahmā āpanā nā jāne || 426 ||

iha bali — saying this; kolakuli kare muni-sane — he embraces the sage; anande vihvala brahma — Brahma, overwhelmed with joy; apana na jane — is unaware of himself

426Saying this, [Brahma] embraces the sage;
beside himself with joy, Brahma forgets himself.

এক কহে আর উঠে গোরা-গুণের প্রভায় ।
সকল ইন্দ্রিয়-সুখ করিবারে চায় ॥ ৪২৭ ॥

eka kahe āra uṭhe gorā-guṇera prabhāẏa |
sakala indriẏa-sukha karibāre cāẏa || 427 ||

eka kahe — he says one thing; ara uthe — another rises; gora-gunera prabhaya — by the splendour of Gora's virtues; sakala indriya-sukha — the joy of all the senses; karibare chaya — he wishes to give

427He says one thing — and another rises [in his heart] by the splendour of Gora's virtues: he longs to delight all his senses [with them].

আর কথা শুন প্রভুর সহস্রেক-নামে ।
এককালে দুই নাম হৈল এক ঠামে ॥ ৪২৮ ॥

āra kathā śuna prabhura sahasreka-nāme |
ekakāle dui nāma haila eka ṭhāme || 428 ||

ara katha shuna — hear something more; prabhura sahasreka-name — in the Thousand Names of the Lord; eka-kale dui nama — names of two [periods] of one [appearance]; haila eka thame — stand in one place

428"Hear more: in the Thousand Names of the Lord
names from two [periods] of one [appearance] stand in one place.17

So in the Mahabharata, Shanti-parva:

সুবর্ণবর্ণো হেমাঙ্গো বরাঙ্গশ্চন্দনাঙ্গদী ।
সন্ন্যাসকৃচ্ছমঃ শান্তো নিষ্ঠাশান্তিপরায়ণঃ ॥ ৪২৯ ॥

subarṇabarṇo hemāṅgo barāṅgaścandanāṅgadī |
sannyāsakṛcchamaḥ śānto niṣṭhāśāntiparāẏaṇaḥ || 429 ||

suvarna-varnah — of golden colour; hema-angah — with limbs like molten gold; vara-angah — of beautiful form; chandana-angadi — adorned with sandal; sannyasa-krit — who takes sannyasa; shamah — equipoised; shantah — peaceful; nishtha-shanti-parayanah — devoted to steadfastness and peace

429'Golden in colour, with limbs like molten gold, of beautiful form, adorned with sandal; taking sannyasa, equipoised, peaceful, devoted to steadfastness and peace.'

হেমগৌর-কলেবর সুবরণ-দ্যুতি ।
সন্ন্যাস-করণে সে পরম মহামতি ॥ ৪৩০ ॥

hemagaura-kalebara subaraṇa-dyuti |
sannyāsa-karaṇe se parama mahāmati || 430 ||

hema-gaura-kalevara — body golden like molten gold; suvarana-dyuti — the lustre of gold; sannyasa-karane — in taking sannyasa; se parama mahamati — He is the supremely wise

430His body is molten gold, His lustre golden;
having taken sannyasa, He is the supremely wise.

ভবিষ্যপুরাণে শুন কৃষ্ণের প্রতিজ্ঞা ।
কলৌ জনমিব তিনবার এই আজ্ঞা ॥ ৪৩১ ॥

bhabiṣyapurāṇe śuna kṛṣṇera pratijñā |
kalau janamiba tinabāra ei ājñā || 431 ||

bhavishya-purane — in the Bhavishya-purana; shuna krishnera pratijna — hear Krishna's vow; kalau janamiba — "I shall be born in Kali"; tinabara ei ajna — this word [is said] three times

431Hear Krishna's vow in the Bhavishya-purana:
'In Kali I shall be born' — three times this word is said.

So in the Bhavishya-purana:

অজায়ধ্বমজায়ধ্বমজায়ধ্বং ন সংশয়ঃ ।
কলৌ সঙ্কীর্তনারম্ভে ভবিষ্যামি শচীসুতঃ ॥ ৪৩২ ॥

ajāẏadhbamajāẏadhbamajāẏadhbaṃ na saṃśaẏaḥ |
kalau saṅkīrtanārambhe bhabiṣyāmi śacīsutaḥ || 432 ||

ajayadhvam ajayadhvam ajayadhvam — "be born, be born, be born" (per Bhaktisiddhanta: "I shall be born" thrice); na samshayah — without doubt; kalau — in Kali; sankirtana-arambhe — at the beginning of sankirtana; bhavishyami shachi-sutah — I shall be the son of Shachi

432'I shall be born, I shall be born, I shall be born — there is no doubt:
in Kali, at the beginning of sankirtana, I shall be the son of Shachi.'18

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
কলিযুগ-ধর্ম-মর্ম বিচারহ মনে ॥ ৪৩৩ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā śuna sābadhāne |
kaliyuga-dharma-marma bicāraha mane || 433 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wonder; shuna savadhane — hear attentively; kali-yuga-dharma-marma — the essence of the dharma of Kali; vicharaha mane — consider in your mind

433Hear attentively yet another wonder
and consider in your mind the essence of the dharma of the Kali-yuga.

পাপময় কলিযুগ বোলে সর্বজনে ।
অধর্ম প্রকট ধর্ম ক্ষীণ আচরণে ॥ ৪৩৪ ॥

pāpamaẏa kaliyuga bole sarbajane |
adharma prakaṭa dharma kṣīṇa ācaraṇe || 434 ||

papamaya kali-yuga — "the Kali-yuga is sinful"; bole sarvajane — say all; adharma prakata — irreligion is manifest; dharma kshina acharane — dharma is weak in conduct

434Everyone says the Kali-yuga is sinful:
irreligion is manifest, dharma is weak in conduct.

হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন এই ধর্ম তার ।
এই পুনঃ হরিনাম সর্বধর্মসার ॥ ৪৩৫ ॥

harināma-saṅkīrtana ei dharma tāra |
ei punaḥ harināma sarbadharmasāra || 435 ||

hari-nama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; ei dharma tara — is its dharma; ei punah hari-nama — and this name of Hari; sarva-dharma-sara — is the essence of all dharmas

435[But] the sankirtana of Hari's name is its dharma,
and this name of Hari is the essence of all dharmas.

দান ব্রত তপো হোম জ্ঞান জপ-ফল ।
অনায়াসে মুক্তি দেই এক নাম-বল ॥ ৪৩৬ ॥

dāna brata tapo homa jñāna japa-phala |
anāẏāse mukti dei eka nāma-bala || 436 ||

dana vrata tapo homa — charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings; jnana japa-phala — the fruits of knowledge and japa; anayase mukti dei — easily grants liberation; eka nama-bala — the power of the name alone

436The fruits of charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings, knowledge and japa,
and liberation without effort, the power of the name alone bestows.

বিষয়ী বিষয়ভোগে নাম করে চিন্তা ।
আগে ভোগ দেই পাছে হরিভক্তি-দাতা ॥ ৪৩৭ ॥

biṣaẏī biṣaẏabhoge nāma kare cintā |
āge bhoga dei pāche haribhakti-dātā || 437 ||

vishayi — a worldly man; vishaya-bhoge — amid sense enjoyment; nama kare chinta — thinks of the name; age bhoga dei — first [the name] gives enjoyment; pachhe hari-bhakti-data — afterwards it bestows devotion to Hari

437Even a worldly man who, amid his pleasures, thinks of the name —
[the name] first gives him enjoyment and then bestows devotion to Hari.19

শ্রদ্ধাবন্ত জন যদি হরিগুণ গায় ।
সব সুখ ছাড়ি প্রভু তার পাছে ধায় ॥ ৪৩৮ ॥

śraddhābanta jana yadi hariguṇa gāẏa |
saba sukha chāṛi prabhu tāra pāche dhāẏa || 438 ||

shraddhavanta jana — a person of faith; yadi hari-guna gaya — if he sings Hari's virtues; saba sukha chhadi — leaving all pleasures; prabhu tara pachhe dhaya — the Lord runs after him

438If a person of faith sings Hari's virtues,
the Lord, leaving all pleasures, runs after him.

এ হেন কৃষ্ণের নাম গুণ সঙ্কীর্তন ।
পাপময় কলিযুগে কৈলা ধর্ম হেন ॥ ৪৩৯ ॥

e hena kṛṣṇera nāma guṇa saṅkīrtana |
pāpamaẏa kaliyuge kailā dharma hena || 439 ||

e hena krishnera nama guna sankirtana — such sankirtana of Krishna's name and virtues; papamaya kali-yuge — in the sinful Kali-yuga; kaila dharma hena — He made the dharma

439Such sankirtana of Krishna's name and virtues
He made the dharma for the sinful Kali-yuga.

যুগের স্বভাব আর যুগধর্ম কহি ।
পাপময় কলিযুগে পরধর্ম এহি ॥ ৪৪০ ॥

yugera sbabhāba āra yugadharma kahi |
pāpamaẏa kaliyuge paradharma ehi || 440 ||

yugera svabhava — the nature of the yuga; ara yuga-dharma kahi — and its dharma I tell; papamaya kali-yuge — in the sinful Kali-yuga; para-dharma ehi — this is the highest dharma

440The nature of the yuga is one thing, and the dharma of the yuga that I name is another: in the sinful Kali-yuga this is the highest dharma.

যদি বা বলিবা পাপ দুশ্ছেদ্য-কারণে ।
প্রকাশিলা মহাখড়্গ নামসঙ্কীর্তনে ॥ ৪৪১ ॥

yadi bā balibā pāpa duśchedya-kāraṇe |
prakāśilā mahākhaṛga nāmasaṅkīrtane || 441 ||

yadi ba baliba — if you ask [why]; papa duchchhedya-karane — because sin is hard to cut; prakashila mahakhadga — He revealed the great sword; nama-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of the name

441If you ask why — because sin is hard to cut:
[for this] He revealed the great sword, the sankirtana of the name.

সত্য-আদি প্রজা কেনে কলিজন্ম মাগে ।
হরিনাম-পরায়ণ হৈব কলিযুগে ॥ ৪৪২ ॥

satya-ādi prajā kene kalijanma māge |
harināma-parāẏaṇa haiba kaliyuge || 442 ||

satya-adi praja — the people of Satya and the other yugas; kene kali-janma mage — why do they ask for birth in Kali; hari-nama-parayana — devoted to Hari's name; haiba kali-yuge — they will be in the Kali-yuga

442Why do the people of Satya and the other yugas ask to be born in Kali?
[Because] in the Kali-yuga they will become devoted to Hari's name.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (11.5.38):

কৃতাদিষু প্রজা রাজন্ কলাবিচ্ছন্তি সম্ভবম্ ।
কলৌ খলু ভবিষ্যন্তি নারায়ণপরায়ণাঃ ॥ ৪৪৩ ॥

kṛtādiṣu prajā rājan kalābicchanti sambhabam |
kalau khalu bhabiṣyanti nārāẏaṇaparāẏaṇāḥ || 443 ||

krita-adishu prajah — the people of Krita and other yugas; rajan — O king; kalau ichchhanti sambhavam — desire birth in Kali; kalau khalu bhavishyanti — for in Kali there will be; narayana-parayanah — those devoted to Narayana

443'The people of Krita and the other yugas, O king, desire to be born in Kali,
for in Kali there will be [people] wholly devoted to Narayana.'

কৃষ্ণ-অবতারে কেনে লঞা সর্বশক্তি ।
পাপাশয় জনে নাহি দেই প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ৪৪৪ ॥

kṛṣṇa-abatāre kene lañā sarbaśakti |
pāpāśaẏa jane nāhi dei premabhakti || 444 ||

krishna-avatare — in the descent of Krishna; kene lana sarva-shakti — why, having taken all potencies; papashaya jane — to people of sinful hearts; nahi dei prema-bhakti — He did not give prema-bhakti

444Why, in the descent of Krishna, appearing with all His potencies,
did He not give prema-bhakti to people of sinful hearts?20

এছন করুণা কহ কোন্ যুগে আর ।
না ভজিতে প্রেম দেই কোন্ অবতার ॥ ৪৪৫ ॥

echana karuṇā kaha kon yuge āra |
nā bhajite prema dei kon abatāra || 445 ||

echhana karuna — such mercy; kaha kon yuge ara — tell, in what other yuga; na bhajite — to those who do not worship; prema dei — gives prema; kon avatara — which avatara

445Tell me: in what other yuga was there such mercy?
Which avatara gives prema to those who do not worship?

পাপনাশ-হেতু আছে ধর্ম কর্ম তীর্থ ।
কি জানহ ধর্মশীল পায় হেন অর্থ ॥ ৪৪৬ ॥

pāpanāśa-hetu āche dharma karma tīrtha |
ki jānaha dharmaśīla pāẏa hena artha || 446 ||

papa-nasha-hetu — for destroying sin; achhe dharma karma tirtha — there are dharma, rites, holy places; ki janaha — do you know whether; dharmashila — the righteous; paya hena artha — obtain such a treasure

446For destroying sin there are dharma, rites, holy places —
but do you know whether the righteous obtain such a treasure?

এতেকে জানিল কলি সর্বযুগসার ।
সঙ্কীর্তনধর্ম বহি ধর্ম নাহি আর ॥ ৪৪৭ ॥

eteke jānila kali sarbayugasāra |
saṅkīrtanadharma bahi dharma nāhi āra || 447 ||

eteke janila — therefore know; kali sarva-yuga-sara — Kali is the essence of all yugas; sankirtana-dharma vahi — apart from the dharma of sankirtana; dharma nahi ara — there is no other dharma

447Know, then: Kali is the essence of all yugas,
and there is no dharma other than the dharma of sankirtana."

এতেক বিচার-কথা কহিল বিরিঞ্চি ।
শুনিঞা নারদ বীণা বাজায় সুসঞ্চি ॥ ৪৪৮ ॥

eteka bicāra-kathā kahila biriñci |
śuniñā nārada bīṇā bājāẏa susañci || 448 ||

eteka vichara-katha — such a discourse; kahila virinchi — Brahma spoke; shuniya — hearing; narada vina bajaya — Narada plays the vina; susanchi — skilfully

448Such a discourse Brahma set forth;
having heard it, Narada skilfully plays his vina.

এহেন অদ্ভুত ব্রহ্মা-নারদ-সম্ভাষ ।
শুনিঞা আনন্দ হিয়া এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৪৯ ॥

ehena adbhuta brahmā-nārada-sambhāṣa |
śuniñā ānanda hiẏā e locanadāsa || 449 ||

ehena adbhuta — such a wondrous; brahma-narada-sambhasha — conversation of Brahma and Narada; shuniya — hearing; ananda hiya — the heart rejoices; e lochanadasa — of this Lochana Dasa

449Hearing such a wondrous conversation of Brahma and Narada,
the heart of this Lochana Dasa rejoices.

✦

Notes

  1. Krishna-varna: literally "dark in colour" or "whose utterance (varna) is 'Krishna'"; tvisha akrishna, "not dark in lustre". In the edition the verse is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation (OCR damaged): krishna-varna — He who describes Krishna; "not dark in lustre" — golden; the "limbs" (anga) — Nityananda and Advaita; the "sub-limbs" (upanga) — Srivasa and others; the "weapons" (astra) — Hari-nama and the like; the "associates" (parshada) — Gadadhara and others. In translation: "The intelligent worship with the sacrifice of sankirtana the Mahapurusha who always reveals the virtues of Krishna and is golden in lustre, together with His limbs, sub-limbs, weapons and associates."
  2. A play on words: varna means both "colour" and "letter, sound". Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3.53.
  3. Lochana Dasa's interpretation: the "limb" (anga) is Balarama, i.e. Nityananda; the "sub-limbs" (upanga) are ornaments. Krishnadasa Kaviraja (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3.66–76) and Bhaktisiddhanta in his anvaya take the "limbs and sub-limbs" as Nityananda, Advaita, Srivasa and the other associates, and the "weapon" as the holy name.
  4. Cf. Kavi Karnapura's Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika, which states which associates of Krishna appeared as whom in Gaura-lila.
  5. Vv. 360–363 set out the opponent's view: for him verse 11.5.32 speaks of a dark avatara of Kali, so that Kali and Dvapara have one colour, and the four yugas only three colours.
  6. Lochana Dasa has in mind the form asan ("were") in Garga's verse: the "yellow" one, not yet appeared, is spoken of in the past tense because His appearance is certain.
  7. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 2 and 3: Krishna is the original Lord (svayam bhagavan), the source of all avataras; when He descends Himself, the yuga-avatara too is present in Him.
  8. The reasoning of vv. 385–390 is condensed: had the verse listed four colours one after another as four past yugas, the order would be strict; since Garga lists white, red and yellow in the past tense and says "now" of the dark one, the order seems broken; but "tatha" shows that yellow is the colour of the future, of the Kali-yuga.
  9. The sense of the verse is unclear. Perhaps the words "but Krishna is Bhagavan Himself" (Bhag. 1.3.28) are meant: which of them is the qualified and which the qualifier (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 2, where it is discussed which word in this verse is subject and which predicate).
  10. Lochana Dasa takes krishnatam gatah not as "has become dark" but as "has become Krishna": the yuga-avatara of every Dvapara is dark, but in this Dvapara Krishna Himself took his place. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3.5–10: Krishna appears once in a day of Brahma, at the end of the Dvapara (of the twenty-eighth chatur-yuga), and in the Kali that follows appears as Sri Chaitanya.
  11. This verse (from the Padma-purana) is also quoted in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6.182), as the Lord's order to Shiva to spread Mayavada scriptures in Kali. In Bhaktisiddhanta's translation in this edition: "I, ever worshipping Shambhu, shall accept this boon: you, appearing as a portion among men in the Dvapara and the following yugas, turn people away from Me by invented scriptures and conceal Me, so that creation may increase." Lochana Dasa cites the verse for the words "in the Dvapara and the following yugas" as an example of the Lord Himself descending in these yugas; this is his own interpretation.
  12. Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya: "the righteous" are those devoted to the Lord's service; "the wicked" are those hostile to devotees; "to establish dharma" is Himself to practise the dharma of each yuga and teach it to living beings.
  13. A play on words: yuga means both "age" and "pair". According to Lochana Dasa, yuge yuge in Gita 4.8 means "in the pair of yugas" — Dvapara and Kali, when the Lord Himself descends — while the partial avataras of every yuga are the subject of verse 4.7 (vv. 409–412).
  14. So Lochana Dasa. The Gaudiya commentators usually refer both 4.7 and 4.8 to the Lord's descents in general; here the author distinguishes: in every yuga a partial avatara, in Dvapara and Kali the Lord Himself.
  15. A has "in an ashrama" (any of the ashramas); the 1983 edition, "under the supreme shelter".
  16. Line 1 is obscure; probably "the bonds of karma fall away only at the dissolution of the world [, and even then not for ever]".
  17. That is, one verse of the Vishnu-sahasranama gives names from two periods of Gaura's life. In Bhaktisiddhanta's translation (the text is partly damaged): the first four names ("golden", "with limbs like gold", "of beautiful form", "adorned with sandal") are marks of the pastimes of household life; the rest, of the pastimes in sannyasa: "taking sannyasa", "equipoised" (absorbed in contemplating Hari's mysteries), "peaceful" (firm in the great sacrifice of Hari-kirtana), "devoted to steadfastness and peace" (to the mahabhava that restrains the non-devotees).
  18. So Bhaktisiddhanta understands this verse: "In Kali, at the beginning of sankirtana, I shall be born as the son of Shachi — I shall be born, I shall be born, I shall be born, there is no doubt." In the 1983 edition the first line differs: "Be born on earth, be born, be born in the form of devotees" — the Lord's command to the gods.
  19. Cf. Bhag. 2.3.10: even one who has all desires, or desires liberation, should worship the Supreme Lord with intense devotion.
  20. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3.14–20 and ch. 4: Krishna reflects that for long He has not given prema-bhakti to the world, and appears as Gaura, giving prema to all without discrimination; cf. Rupa Gosvami's verse anarpita-charim chirat…
